title: Li Tsung Woo

page_data.en:
Aº
Shanghai Municipal Council.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 562
Date 9 - 9 - 16
6th September 1916.

Sir,
It is reported that Li Tsung Woo 李徵五 who was implicated in the Yunnan opium smuggling case, has an office at 155 Avenue Joffre and is there recruiting men to proceed to Mongolia for service there. The expedition will be called the Voo Koh Tau Nyuh Kyuin 護國討逆軍 meaning the "Army to suppress the Rebellion".

It is reported that Zee Nyeu Kau 徐元誥, the new Taoyin, will arrive on the 7th instant and that after he takes over his post, ex-Taoyin Chow with his son will be engaged on Government railway affairs.

One hundred and eighty four Hupeh famine refugees who have been moving about in this vicinity particularly in the Pootung district for a long time and who have been camped at Ying Ziang Kong for the last three days are leaving to-day for Woosung.

MS.

Your obedient servant,
[签名]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entries on m.s. Sep. 6

Aº
上海工部局。
（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探股）
刑事侦缉处
I. O. REG
第 562 号
日期 16 - 9 - 9
1916年9月6日。

先生：

据报，牵涉云南鸦片走私案的李徵五，在霞飞路155号设有办事处，并正在那里招募人员前往蒙古服役。该远征军将称为“護國討逆軍”，意为“讨伐叛逆之军”。

据报，新任道尹徐元誥将于本月7日抵达，在其接任后，前任道尹周及其子将投身于政府铁路事务。

一百八十四名湖北饥民难民长期以来在本地区特别是浦东一带流动，并在过去三天露营于营江公（音译），他们将于今日启程前往吴淞。

MS.

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警察总监。

手写批注 9月6日
